component.name: Rustidian
component.summary: Native Markdown notebook for local vaults

description.p: Rustidian is a fast, native Markdown notebook for Linux. Your notes stay as plain files in ordinary folders; no account is needed.
It opens Obsidian-format vaults. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Obsidian.

ul.li: Tasks, tables, callouts and Mermaid diagrams
Daily notes, templates, bookmarks and graph views
